messages:
maria_cs: Hey team — Aurelius Health signed last night. I want to run a tight first-48h activation plan to make sure we hit their P0s and capture feedback for the renewal play. @oliver_pm @sam_se can you confirm owners for PM/Eng?

oliver_pm: I can own PM side. will set expectations w/ stakeholders. will sync on scope (SSO + limited prod traffic). :white_check_mark:

sam_se: Eng lead here — I'll pair with Aurelius' infra engineer for SSO and create a debug token for early tests. ETA for SSO prototype: EOD tomorrow.

nina_cust: Aurelius contact is Priya (priya@aurelius.health). They want a short enablement session for data access and prompt examples in the first week. Also asked about audit logs for compliance.

ryan_success: I'll own renewal-risk tracking. Quick plan: if we don't have SSO + first 100 inference hits in 14 days, mark as yellow risk. I'll add a health-check cadence: 48h, 7d, 14d, 30d.

maria_cs: Perfect. Proposed minimal first-48h checklist to be copied into their workspace and run with owner tags: 
```
T+0: PM intro call scheduled (oliver_pm)
T+8h: eng access + test keys handed to Aurelius (sam_se)
T+24h: SSO flow validation (sam_se + priya)
T+48h: first 10 end-to-end requests + basic eval (maria_cs)
Capture: short feedback form sent after T+48h (ryan_success)
```

maria_cs: Links: onboarding doc https://redwood.internal/onboards/aurelius, sample prompts https://redwood.internal/onboards/templates/prompt-suite.md

onboard-bot: Created task CS-1147 "Aurelius 48h activation" and assigned to maria_cs, sam_se, oliver_pm. Ticket: https://tickets.redwood/C S-1147

sam_se: FYI — I need access to their IdP metadata. @nina_cust can you intro or paste SAML metadata here?

nina_cust: Priya asked for the enablement session to be 30 minutes max and prefers Wed 11am PT. I’ll send calendar invite once PM confirms.

oliver_pm: Wed 11am PT works for us. I'll send invite and include an agenda: 1) Goals, 2) SSO walk-through, 3) first-run checklist, 4) Qs.

ryan_success: I'll draft a 5-question feedback form we can push after T+48h. Quick items to capture: perceived latency, prompt quality, ease of integration, support response, renewal concern (Y/N + free text).

maria_cs: Good. Omar from legal wants a short note about data residency — tagging @oliver_pm to capture in PM notes.

oliver_pm: noted. I'll include a data residency checkbox in the kickoff deck.

maria_cs: Ok team, action items summary: oliver -> invite + deck; sam -> SSO prototype + debug token; ryan -> feedback form + risk rule; nina -> intro to Priya + SAML; I'll run the first-eval and log results to the onboarding doc. Please update CS-1147 as you make progress. :thumbsup:

sam_se: On it.

nina_cust: Intro sent to Priya and included SAML metadata (pasted privately).

ryan_success: Draft feedback form uploaded to CS drive: https://drive.redwood/onboards/aurelius/feedback-form.md

maria_cs: Closing loop here — we'll reconvene in this thread after the 48h check. Thanks everyone! :sparkles:
